task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from an S3 URI like 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/object' and extract just the bucket name
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly match and capture bucket names from S3 URIs, handling bucket names with hyphens and numbers, and work for both s3:// and https:// formats

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that includes function name, runtime (Python 3.11), timeout (60 seconds), memory (512 MB), and environment variables for API_KEY and REGION
solution_criteria: The JSON object should have valid structure with all required Lambda configuration fields and environment variables properly nested

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS CloudWatch log event as input and returns a dictionary with extracted timestamp, log level (ERROR, WARN, INFO), and message content
solution_criteria: The function should parse unstructured log strings, correctly identify log levels using pattern matching, and return a clean dictionary with the three required fields
